ryscope.settings.title: RYScope settings
ryscope.settings.ui_scale.note: Window size for all RYS mods. Independent of the game GUI Scale.
ryscope.status.state.order: Missing items can be ordered from the AE2 network
ryscope.settings.fuzzy.note: Used only when the exact search finds almost nothing
ryscope.settings.languages.note: All languages: longer first indexing, search works in any language
ryscope.settings.cheat.note: In creative mode, or for an operator in survival when RYScope is installed on the server. A click puts the item on the cursor, Shift: a full stack, Alt: into the inventory; clicking the list with an item on the cursor deletes it. Outside the creative inventory the cursor and deleting need RYScope on the server, otherwise the item goes into the inventory. From the recipe card items always go into the inventory
ryscope.settings.replace_jei.note: Takes effect after restarting the game
ryscope.settings.footer: Keys: Options → Controls → Key Binds → RYScope
ryscope.source.note.player: Only when killed by a player

ryscope.source.note.looting: Looting increases the amount or chance
ryscope.board.added: Goal pinned: shown on screen while you play
ryscope.board.unsupported: Only items can be pinned as goals
ryscope.settings.board.note: Shows what is still missing for pinned goals: the pin next to a recipe or the button in the crafting tree
